نتحامل (form VI)
# نَتَحَامَلُ (nataḥāmalu) /na.ta.ħaː.ma.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَحَامَلَ (taḥāmala)
# نَتَحَامَلَ (nataḥāmala) /na.ta.ħaː.ma.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَحَامَلَ (taḥāmala)
# نَتَحَامَلْ (nataḥāmal) /na.ta.ħaː.mal/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَحَامَلَ (taḥāmala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
